label: Ginsburg holding the Bill of Rights as tablets, Epstein smirking beside her
description: Ruth Bader Ginsburg seen holding the Bill of Rights as stone tablets like the Ten Commandments with the First Amendment carved bold, about to fall out of her fingers, and Epstein walking up beside her looking at them with a smirk while the rest of the Supreme Court stands behind. He notes on air that both figures are dead, which makes the scene emblematic rather than predictive.
aliases: they were about to fall out of her hands
I saw Epstein walk right up beside her
she had a doily collar

label: The Empire State Building lit with a foreign flag and a demon face
description: The New York mayor lighting the Empire State Building with what he first calls the Palestinian flag and the next day identifies as the Iranian flag, with a grey demon face with a red tongue and sharp teeth on it, celebrated with little outcry, which he says will show the heart of New York. The building is privately owned and its lighting is decided by the owners rather than the mayor, and the named flag changes between tellings.
aliases: he lit it up with the Palestinian flag
It's the Iranian flag
there will be not much outcry against it

label: The First Amendment given up freely while the Second is defended
description: A black widow cocooning the First Amendment while a black steel plate protects the Second, with the word that the First will be stripped away by a chiselling grain by grain, that people will fight hardest for the Second without realising they are being silenced, that the First is more important than the Second, and that the Supreme Court is the danger. Extended to Canada, England, France, Germany, Italy and Australia.
aliases: So freely you will give the first, but you'll fight for the second
The first amendment is more important than the second
Your First Amendment rights are in danger by the Supreme Court

label: Niagara Falls full of debris and dirty water
description: Niagara Falls full of debris, trash and dirty water with bicycle parts and tennis rackets floating down it as if from a flood or storm damage, with great darkness over it, seen while looking at Canada. The debris is his image for the state of Canada as much as a physical event.
aliases: Niagara Falls was full of debris and trash

description: The sound of an abundance of rain heard over the land with authority taken over drought in Oklahoma, Texas, Kansas, Missouri, Alabama, Mississippi, Tennessee, North Carolina and Georgia, followed by corn and crops coming up all over Tennessee. Nine states named at once means partial rain somewhere is guaranteed.

label: Big factory layoffs coming in Missouri
description: Factory workers seen in Missouri with big layoffs coming to those factories, something wrong there, and a repeated phrase that the attempt to turn it around is too little too late. Naming one state makes this checkable against state-level layoff notices.

label: The generation that put Trump in does not turn out to vote
description: The middle class hurt by gas, food, inflation, housing and retirement with 401ks taking a big hit, and the boomers who put Trump in not getting out to vote, with no rally and no war cry anymore. Turnout among over-65s is the most stable in American politics, which makes this a real prediction against the base rate.

description: The new man at the Fed trying to bring rates down by a quarter point, with the words too broke and too hot repeated, and the man looking at the real books for the first time, alongside Jerome Powell seen gone reluctantly. Powell's term as chair ends in May 2026, weeks after this was given.
